title: Spain orders the expulsion of its Jews
summary: Ferdinand and Isabella signed the Alhambra Decree, ordering all Jews in Castile and Aragon to convert to Christianity or leave by the end of July.
reason: The monarchs, urged by the Inquisition, wanted religious unity after the conquest of Granada and blamed Jews for influencing converts.
significance: It ended centuries of Jewish life in Spain and scattered Sephardic communities across the Mediterranean and beyond.
